decisive_items: apex of the heart located at the right side of the chest
right atrium and right ventricle laid on the left side and the left atrium and left ventricle on the right side with its apex directed to the right
hepatic dullness that was located in the left subcostal region
response.rationale: The physical exam and echocardiogram clearly demonstrate dextrocardia with situs inversus, which explains the ECG findings. The RBBB is a secondary manifestation of the reversed cardiac anatomy.

rejected.why: Complete RBBB is a consequence of the underlying situs inversus and dextrocardia, not the primary diagnosis.
